name: Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company operates under the Torikizoku, Toriki Burger, Yakitori Daikichi, zoku, HASU, mozu, Yakitori Taimatsu, and Yakitori Hachibei Kitashinchi brands. It is also involved in operation and development of managed stores; and provision of franchise management services. The company was formerly known as Torikizoku Holdings Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. in May 2024. Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
